To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cardiovascular responses to plyometric exercises are affected by different workloads in athletes.
the post-exercise cardiovascular responses to plyometric exercises are affected by the workload in athletes.
plyometric exercise with different workload induces different post-exercise cardiovascular responses in athletes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the cardiovascular responses to different workloads in athletes.
the influence of workload of plyometric exercises on post-exercise cardiovascular responses.
the influence of workload in cardiovascular responses during and after plyometric exercise.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the workload of plyometric exercises influences the cardiovascular responses.
the workload of plyometric exercises affects post-exercise SB, HR and RRP responses.
the workload of the plyometric exercise affects the post-exercise cardiovascular responses in athletes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LW of plyometric exercise can be used as a tool for reducing blood pressure.
the post-exercise SBPs, DBPs, HRs and RPPs are not different among the different workload of plyometric exercises.
plyometric exercise is an effective method for improving cardiovascular health and that the workload of this exercise modality is important to consider.

plyometric exercise is an effective training method that increases cardiovascular responses.
the cardiovascular responses are affected by workload during plyometric exercise.
strength and conditioning professionals must consider the workload when prescribing plyometric exercise.
